The main takeaway from our work is that
the joint learning of multi-agent control policy and barrier certificates can lead to a scalable and robust multi-agent control approach.

the multi-agent control barrier function framework can be extended to a large class of multi-agent systems with arbitrary numbers of agents and dynamics, and the resulting control policy can be used in complex multi-agent scenarios.
the proposed framework can be applied to a wide range of multi-agent problems, and the proposed spontaneous refinement can be applied to any existing multi-agent learning methods.
